name: ASM HHV ENGINEERING PRIVATE LIMITED
india_angle: ASM-HHV Engineering is India's first semiconductor and Solar PV focused equipment manufacturer.
summary: ASM-HHV Engineering specializes in the manufacturing of equipment for the semiconductor and solar PV industries, focusing on design-led and contract manufacturing services. They offer solutions ranging from prototyping to build-to-spec and build-to-print services, catering to the specific needs of semiconductor equipment production.
